items.question: What offering materials, quantity, and practitioner discipline are required for performing this oblation?
premises: The oblation is to be performed using red full-blown flowers.
The prescribed quantity of the offering is one thousand.
The practitioner performing the oblation must have conquered the senses.
items.inference: A sense-controlled practitioner should offer one thousand red full-blown flowers in this oblation.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'tat' depends on prior context not included in this verse.
items.plain_english: One who has conquered the senses should offer that thousand with red, full-blown flowers.
